lens: Geometry and proportion first. New measurement script /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/34470b21-5ad4-5cec-977a-20c7657c0e01/scratchpad/raterB37/m.py: patch stats for r36 (eb4c09f) and r37 (8b965a4) against the ANA photos resized to 930x575. I also measured per-seat pan, back and cover boxes on q15, with the photo boxes placed on the same features. Crops: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/34470b21-5ad4-5cec-977a-20c7657c0e01/scratchpad/raterB37/pair15.png (q15 vs y_47300), /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/34470b21-5ad4-5cec-977a-20c7657c0e01/scratchpad/raterB37/z_low.png (q15 near seats, r36 | r37), /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/34470b21-5ad4-5cec-977a-20c7657c0e01/scratchpad/raterB37/z_far.png (q15 far rows vs y_47300), /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/34470b21-5ad4-5cec-977a-20c7657c0e01/scratchpad/raterB37/c_e10.png (studio e10 under-seat, s36 | s37) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/34470b21-5ad4-5cec-977a-20c7657c0e01/scratchpad/raterB37/p302crop.png (y_47302 under-seat). The r36 vs r37 diff changes 2.4 % of q15 pixels, mostly on rows 325-425 (the tick backs, 6-7 %), 1.0 % of q16 and 0.3 % of q17. Among the studio units only e10_under moves noticeably (2.7 %). Two things changed: the y_tick layer now fades by -0.25 instead of 0 (04_shaders.js), which brings back a little stitch contrast, and the pouch is recoloured.

priorIssues.note: q15 far box (300-640, 150-200) reads L133.5 B/R 1.31 p90/p10 3.32 vs y_47300 112.3 / 1.48 / 4.98, identical to r36. The mid box (250-690, 200-250) reads L90.3 / 1.68 / 2.77 vs 80.3 / 1.75 / 3.29. In z_far the rows still show white fleck snow and light headrest tops, with no dark gaps between rows. Note: econ groups switch LOD at 9.5 x nearK 0.66 = 6.3 m (09_seats.js:257), so the first ~7 rows in q15 are near LOD.

priorIssues.id: w36b-2 (low) pouch an opaque brown bowl
priorIssues.note: The hue is fixed: in s37 e10 the core is (32,34,41) #20222a, cool, no longer the brown #2b201d. It is now too dark and still opaque. The y_47302 shield samples (48,45,48)-(60,60,68), with the leg, the rail and a vest glint visible through it, and the red strap hangs below the rim. Ours is a near-black half-disc with a pale lit rim, and the strap stays inside the disc.

priorIssues.id: w36b-3 (low) pans too blue; tick flat
priorIssues.note: Tick contrast is up through the shader change. Seat 2 pan p90/p10 went from 2.79 to 3.42 (photo 4.45) and seat 1 from 2.87 to 3.20 (photo 4.86). On the tick back (seat 3) it went from 2.72 to 3.23 (photo 3.46), so that one is nearly matched. The hue is unchanged: pan B/R is 2.00 / 1.99 (tick), 1.89 (lattice) and 2.06 (dash) against 1.80 / 1.73 / 1.82 / 1.72.

priorIssues.id: w36b-4 (low) pillows plaques; fleck halos; belt V
priorIssues.note: z_low shows no change: rounded-rect pillows, a belt V and two light buckle blocks on every pan.

priorIssues.id: w36b-5 (low) cover light; black tray lip
priorIssues.note: q15 cover2 reads L54.2 B/R 1.64, unchanged. Measured box-for-box on the photo cover it is 59.0 / 1.83, so the L is now within noise but the cover is less blue than the photo. The tray lip is unchanged (e11 moved 1.3 %, from the shader only).
Full-frame L 124.4 vs 118.8. Far rows +21 L.

Lattice pan L77.8 B/R 1.89 p90/p10 1.56 vs 72.8 / 1.82 / 1.86. Unchanged.
Dash pan L76.1 B/R 2.06 vs 80.9 / 1.72, so it is still too blue. Unchanged.
Unchanged geometry. Cover L54 vs 59 box-for-box, B/R 1.64 vs 1.83.
Unchanged geometry. The hard tray lip remains.
Up 0.1. The pouch is now cool grey rather than brown, but its core (32,34,41) is darker than the y_47302 shield (48-60), it is opaque and the strap is too short.

issues.owner: econ (09a_econ.js) + seats (09_seats.js nearK, shared one line)
issues.title: Mid/far rows still snowy and light, with no dark row gaps (5 rounds)
issues.evidence: q15 far box L133.5 B/R 1.31 p90/p10 3.32 vs 112.3 / 1.48 / 4.98 (same as w36). Mid box L90.3 / 1.68 vs 80.3 / 1.75. Econ switches to far LOD at 9.5 x 0.66 = 6.3 m, so rows 1-7 of q15 use the near-LOD photo tiles, and those alias into white fleck snow.
issues.fix: In 09_seats.js:257 (shared, one line), set nearK for /^y/ from 0.66 to 0.42 (switch at ~4 m), so rows 5+ take econUnitFar. Then darken ECON_FAR about 10 % and make it bluer (yFabric '#57628a' -> '#4c5682', yFabricB '#57629a' -> '#4c5690', yFabricC '#4f5b82' -> '#46507a', ECON_HEAD_L '#5d6a95' -> '#52608c'). Re-measure the far box against a target of L~112, B/R ~1.48. If the switch pops visibly, fall back to fading the photo tile toward its mean with smoothstep(3.5, 6.0, dist) for layers 16-19 in 04_shaders.js.

issues.title: All three near pan fabrics ~10 % too blue
issues.evidence: Pan B/R: tick 2.00 / 1.99 vs 1.80 / 1.73, dash 2.06 vs 1.72, lattice 1.89 vs 1.82. Ls are within ±6.
issues.fix: ECON_PAN photoBase '#4b537a' -> '#4d5472'. ECON_PAN_C '#444c72' -> '#474e69'. Leave ECON_PAN_B. Target B/R ~1.80 at the same L.

issues.title: Life-vest pouch: now cool, but too dark, opaque and with a short strap
issues.evidence: s37 e10: core (32,34,41). The y_47302 shield samples (48,45,48)-(60,60,68), shows the leg and rail through it, and its red strap hangs below the rim (p302crop).
issues.fix: In 09a_econ.js:186, inner core c '#3a3c44' -> '#4c4e56' and r 0.3 -> 0.45. Red strap gBox(0.018, 0.075, 0.004) at y 0.20 -> gBox(0.018, 0.11, 0.004) at y 0.18, so it hangs ~3 cm below the rim. Optional: a 0.03 x 0.012 '#8a7350' glint box on the core face.

issues.title: Pillows plain plaques; fleck halos; belt V and buckle blocks on every pan (carried)
issues.evidence: z_low: unchanged. y_47300 shows puffed bow-tie pillows and no belts.
issues.fix: As w36b-4: loft the pillow with its corners pulled out 1.5 cm and the mid-edges pinched 1 cm, and clamp the y_fleck dark end. Belts depend on the user's choice (open question).

issues.title: Headrest cover slightly less blue than the photo; hard black tray lip under the pan fronts (carried)
issues.evidence: Cover2 L54.2 B/R 1.64 vs 59.0 / 1.83 box-for-box. e11 shows the crisp tray edge.
issues.fix: SEATMAT.yCover c '#222842' -> '#232a4a' (shared, one line). Tray gRBox depth 0.41 -> 0.39, set 2 cm aft, r 0.8.

issues.title: Far-row exposure (not scored for econ)
issues.evidence: The far box is +21 L. Part of this is the near-LOD snow (w37b-1); the rest is the light distribution down the aisle.
